purpose: low-cost preference ranking, not diffusion optimization or training
calibration: leave-original-video-out; fit only other videos replay labels; no heldout label fitting
features: MUSIQ, LPIPS to TAU, low-frequency content change, unsupported detail to last observed frame, fixed TAU-flow warp residual and edit residual/flicker
flow: Farneback RGB only, same for all candidates, forward-backward mask
selection: max calibrated score relative TAU; reject if <=0; no target gating
stress: blur/sharpen/independent noise/persistent texture; secondary controls, excluded from fit and natural selection
limits: 7 validation videos, partial sources, no claim of generalization; inability to measure positive recall if no safe repairs
